raw:
@q query
  select ?w
  where match
    relation "win"
    role subject ?w
    role object "the mayor's office in Bârlad"
    role time "last year"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "remain"
    role subject "the old one"
    polarity affirmed
  end
